produced_by: claude-fable-5-1, ten parallel labellers over a stratified sample; spot-checked by claude-opus-5 on low-confidence labels and on disagreements with the classifier
notes: 374 reviews: 20 per predicted category plus a random tail, so per-category figures are possible without the sample being purely the classifier's own view.

Because no person has checked these labels, results measured against this set are AGREEMENT WITH A MODEL and must never be reported as accuracy. Two language models agreeing can be wrong together, and the sarcasm and category-boundary cases where this classifier is weakest are exactly where that correlation is strongest.

Spot check found the reference labels better than the classifier on roughly nine of ten disagreements: 'good' was classified as price, 'amauzing' as audio, and a Chinese review about exploration and skills as bugs. One review of 374 received seven secondary categories, which edges towards over-assignment on long text.
Set human_verified to true only once a person has labelled a subset independently, and record how large that subset was.
